newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Pol Pot said "surrendered" to ex-comrades-radio.
newsitem.headline: Pol Pot said "surrendered" to ex-comrades-radio.

text.p: Pol Pot, the leader of Cambodia's Khmer Rouge guerrilla group, has turned himself in to his former comrades, Khmer Rouge radio reported on Wednesday.
The radio, under control of a rival rebel faction which has broken with the notorious leader of the 1975-79 "killing fields" regime, said he had surrendered.
"The darkness of the brutal regime of Pol Pot which hung over Cambodia since 1975... now the Cambodian people have destroyed it completely," the radio said.
"The new regime has started," it said.
The radio gave no further details as to the whereabouts or fate of Pol Pot. The report could not be independently confirmed.
Cambodia's First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh said last week that the Khmer Rouge had split and most of Pol Pot's supporters had turned against him.
